items.title: Top Analyst Reports for Dell, Marvell & Verizon Communications
items.summary: Today's Research Daily features new research reports on 16 major stocks, including Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL), Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL) and Verizon Communications Inc. (VZ), as well as two micro-cap stocks, Tandy Leather Factory, Inc. (TLF) and Moving iMage Technologies, Inc. (MITQ).

items.title: The Premium On AAPL Stock Vs What Its Peers Deliver
items.summary: Apple's stock commands a premium price among its peers, but its growth and profit metrics tell a different story. Is the market paying for the past or the future.

items.title: The Cheapest Part Of Dell's Compounding Machine Just Got Expensive
items.summary: A shrinking share count has handed Dell holders faster earnings growth than the business itself produced, and the stock's run has just made that machine much costlier to keep running.

items.title: Knightvest Buys Discounted Austin Apartment Portfolio
items.summary: Knightvest Capital acquired a 1,027-unit Austin apartment portfolio at a steep discount, betting on a market rebound.

items.title: Zoom Video Gears Up to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
items.summary: ZM heads into Q2 with Enterprise strength and AI monetization gains, while Online softness, churn and currency remain key offsets.

items.title: HPQ Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: HP's AI PC momentum and Windows 11 refresh cycle can lift Q3 revenues, but rising memory and transportation costs may pressure margins.

items.title: SMTC Set to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
items.summary: Semtech heads into Q2 with revenues and EPS expected to rise sharply, as data centers, LoRa and premium handsets drive growth.

items.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Dell, Celestica, Lumentum and Vertiv
items.summary: AI data centers need more than chips. Dell, Celestica, Lumentum and Vertiv are poised to benefit from surging demand for critical infrastructure.
